This is libcurl.js 0.7.5 with local request-header and WebSocket patches.

empty-headers.patch changes the HTTP encoder to use curl's documented "Name;"
syntax for explicitly empty header fields. It also omits the WebSocket protocol
header when no subprotocols were requested, and keeps an absent upload
Content-Type distinct from an explicitly empty Content-Type.
websocket-close.patch preserves close codes and UTF-8 reasons, echoes server
close frames, and waits for a peer's close reply after a client requests closing.
websocket-messages.patch reassembles fragmented text/binary messages, excludes
control payloads from message events and uses frame metadata at receive boundaries.
The Emscripten 3.1.72 build also needs its socket URL and bundled-WASM startup
rewrites to accept that compiler's output. The curl CA blob is passed by
pointer, as required by CURLOPT_CAINFO_BLOB. The build machine's default CA
directory is cleared; TLS certificate checks use the embedded root bundle.

source-lock.json identifies the upstream sources, Emscripten version and CA
bundle used for this build. The library and its dependencies retain their
upstream licenses. libcurl.js is LGPL-3.0-or-later; the prebuilt package
includes its LICENSE, upstream documentation, patch and source revision list.
Dependency license notices are included under licenses/ in the package.

To rebuild, use Linux/WSL with Emscripten 3.1.72 activated and the ordinary
upstream build prerequisites (git, Python 3, make, autoconf, automake, libtool,
cmake, pkg-config, jq and wget). Run:

  node vendor/libcurl/rebuild.mjs

The optional first argument selects a fresh build directory without spaces.
SANDSTONE_BUILD_JOBS defaults to 2. Rebuilding downloads the locked source
revisions and writes the prebuilt tarball next to this file. Native compiler
tools are needed only to regenerate that tarball; normal npm ci/build and the
standalone HTML use the prebuilt package.

Upstream source: https://github.com/ading2210/libcurl.js
curl header format: https://curl.se/libcurl/c/CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER.html
